Put your iPad, preferably in a water-proof bag, at one end of the pool. Set your interval time and the number of laps for your training. Hit "Start" and begin your relaxation watching the preparation timer.
Once the preparation timer reaches zero, start to dive your first lap.
While recovering for you next dive, watch the interval timer and start your next lap when it reaches zero.
